Record Class TomlTable

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
be.imgn.toml.TomlTable
Record Components:
entries - the entries, which keep their iteration order; the map is copied
All Implemented Interfaces:
TomlValue
public record TomlTable(Map<String, TomlValue> entries) extends Record implements TomlValue
A TOML table: keys mapped to values, in the order the keys were given or appeared in the document.

Besides entries(), a table looks its values up by a TOML key, which can be dotted and quoted as in a document. get("server.port") is the value of the key port in the table server, and get("site.\"example.com\"") the value of the key example.com in the table site. The typed getters, such as getString(String), also check the type of the value.

Two tables are equal when they have the same entries, whatever their order.

Since:
0.1.0
